objective: Open the complete SUNNYVAiLE experience with every advertised building genuinely useful, connected and proven. Build phases are execution order only; no canonical building is omitted from opening day.
opening_day_release_rule: Every building and shared system in this manifest must reach VERIFIED LOCALLY on the exact release candidate, then VERIFIED PUBLICLY after deployment. A route, mock, draft, local file or bounded component pass is not enough.
scope_boundary: Opening day includes every canonical building and the launch catalogue below. It does not require every future class, book, shop item, room, collectible or idea-log entry. Anything not in the launch catalogue remains visibly unavailable and retains a named later-release trigger.

opening_day: Episode 01 — On Wednesdays We Do AI
Episode 02 — Tell Me What You Want
episode_cutline.requirement_before_opening: The Episode 05 brief, production path, complement handoffs, media metadata, correction propagation and Wednesday release runbook must already be operational; Episode 05 itself is not part of opening-day public content.

launch_catalogue.episodes: Trailer and Episodes 01–04, each with the admitted read, listen and watch experience, cover/metadata, sources where applicable and related-learning links.
launch_catalogue.classes: Three complete pathways: AI foundations; setting up and using an AI tool well; and an intermediate practical lab titled What the Viral Reel Left Out. Each includes an outcome, lesson, worked example, Try-On/practice, check, sources/freshness and next step.
launch_catalogue.library_books: Four editorially admitted durable references: Vocab 101, Briefing 101, Setup 101 and Accounts 101, reconciled against duplicate/stale Grimoire material and connected to relevant episodes, classes, news and tools.
launch_catalogue.study_packs: One complete Episode 01 Study Pack containing exactly the one-page Cheat Sheet, one Try-On and one Trading Card Pack. The Pop Quiz stays at SUNNYVAiLE High.
launch_catalogue.news: One complete opening-day Daily paper plus at least three current, sourced NewsStand stories with direct pages, newest/archive/topic/search discovery, corrections and related learning.
launch_catalogue.daily: A functioning daily rotation for AI news, Paige's useful tip, What the Viral Reel Left Out, Promptoscope, Mme CLAi-O reading, Song of the Day, town notes and one anti-cringe curiosity or mutual-support note. Sourced reporting and fictional town fun are unmistakably separated.
launch_catalogue.music: All 29 creator-confirmed KSVL tracks with functioning players, canonical titles/artists/artwork, playlists and take-it-with-me metadata.
launch_catalogue.luminairy: At least six fully sourced, rights-cleared profiles balanced across women who shaped computing's past and women shaping AI now.
launch_catalogue.community: At least one usable general community room and one clearly scoped Resident/Girl Talk room with real post/reply, unread, report/block, moderation and failure/retry behavior.
launch_catalogue.games_and_tools: Every game or tool promoted from the Homepage/directory has one complete, comprehensible and useful visitor journey; opening-day promotion cannot point to previews, generic shells or fake completion.

shared_systems.opening_day_floor: Preserve the approved masthead and intro. Present four clear sections, Daily Buzz as a distinct side rail, visible sign-in and direct links to every opening-day destination without duplicated or buried journeys.
shared_systems.acceptance_proof: First-time, signed-out returning and signed-in returning journeys pass at 320, 390, intermediate and desktop widths with no clipping, dead space, misleading availability or broken links.
shared_systems.next_action: Return to the last accepted pre-reorganization candidate and rebuild only against the locked four-section content contract.

shared_systems.opening_day_floor: Resident Card creation/sign-in, local-safe signed-out use, account-backed Card/Closet/progress continuation, My Closet entry, UI sign-out and truthful cross-device behavior.
shared_systems.acceptance_proof: Disposable-account UI proof covers entry, reload, cross-context restore, native Closet add/remove, account isolation, sign-out/fail-closed behavior and cleanup without using personal production data.
shared_systems.next_action: Provision isolated staging plus a non-personal mail sink, then run the held account-entry matrix.

shared_systems.opening_day_floor: One authoritative Butterfly Clip ledger records current balance, lifetime earned, lifetime spent/refunded and what each transaction was for. FAiRY Plays use the same ledger and may be redeemed one way from Clips after a confirmed exchange.
shared_systems.acceptance_proof: At least one real earn, one spend, one refund/retry and one Clip-to-Play redemption pass idempotency, account isolation, visible receipt and cross-context balance tests.
shared_systems.next_action: Lock the initial earn table and launch redemption catalogue, then implement the ledger API and first vertical slice.

shared_systems.opening_day_floor: Every released item is indexed, searchable and connected to appropriate learn-more locations across episodes, books, classes, news, Daily, tools and games. Contradictions and freshness changes create owned correction orders.
shared_systems.acceptance_proof: The launch catalogue passes ingestion, search, related-content, contradiction, sitemap/feed, canonical/share metadata and correction-propagation checks on the exact release artifact.
shared_systems.next_action: Resolve the existing relationship queue and bind each launch-catalogue artifact to its exact consumer set.

shared_systems.opening_day_floor: Every episode, class lesson, demonstration, explainer, music video, promo, ident, silent instructional animation and ambient loop is reviewed occurrence by occurrence against its exact narration or visitor purpose before binding.
shared_systems.acceptance_proof: The exact master and every occurrence pass relevance, timing, continuity, identity, occlusion and motion-semantics review in the real responsive player; a sampled review, zoomed still or motion metric cannot substitute.
shared_systems.next_action: Complete the Trailer and Episodes 01–04 occurrence audits and apply the same registry contract to each class or other motion asset as it is built.

shared_systems.opening_day_floor: Episodes and songs have one checksum-bound version record, approved cover/crop family, correct artist/episode metadata, website playback and prepared podcast/YouTube/music-platform destinations. Freshness corrections propagate everywhere.
shared_systems.acceptance_proof: Trailer and Episodes 01–04 plus all opening KSVL tracks reproduce exact manifest identities across website and every admitted external feed/channel; successor tests prove correction replacement.
shared_systems.next_action: Populate canonical manifests and platform mappings, then prepare the opening-day distribution package without publishing before release admission.

shared_systems.opening_day_floor: Residents can find messages and unread state from mobile or desktop; community contributions have report/block/moderation, receipt, failure and retry behavior.
shared_systems.acceptance_proof: Two-account message/post/reply/unread/report/block/moderation tests pass with privacy, accessibility, rate-limit and account-isolation evidence.
shared_systems.next_action: Reconcile the existing messaging service and expose it through Sorority House and My Closet without inventing a second system.

shared_systems.opening_day_floor: Privacy-safe site health, agent health, releases, signups, visitors, popular/unpopular journeys, schedule, social status, blockers and evidence-backed recommendations are visible in the secure mobile Control Room.
shared_systems.acceptance_proof: Authorized aggregate sources populate without private-data leakage; unknown stays null; every Ali action produces an immutable receipt and returns to its owner queue.
shared_systems.next_action: Connect approved read-only analytics and verified signup aggregates after access is provisioned; keep mutation controls disabled until authentication and receipts pass.

shared_systems.opening_day_floor: Shared header/navigation, responsive behavior, accessibility, privacy/security, performance, error handling and visitor-language standards apply across the whole town.
shared_systems.acceptance_proof: Continuous full-page desktop/intermediate/mobile captures and automated/manual accessibility, link, media, console, performance and failure-state checks pass the exact candidate and public deployment.
shared_systems.next_action: Use the 28-route inventory as the regression set and close shared failures before building-specific release gates.

buildings.name: Visitor’s Centre
buildings.opening_day_floor: A complete first-arrival orientation with the Trailer, how SUNNYVAiLE/LAiDIES works, an accurate town directory, suggested starts for new and returning visitors and direct handoff to every open building.
buildings.acceptance_proof: First visit, returning signed-out and signed-in routes are comprehensible and complete on desktop/mobile; no rejected white shell, fake map or dead destination remains.
buildings.next_action: Recover the last complete orientation experience and rebuild it in the accepted building-as-interface visual language.

buildings.name: NewsStand
buildings.opening_day_floor: The Daily newspaper, at least three current sourced launch stories, newest/archive/topic/search, exact sources, corrections, related learning and clearly labelled fictional town sections.
buildings.acceptance_proof: Every launch story passes the full publication-validation-and-discovery chain; the Daily rotates correctly and stale/held/retracted items are suppressed.
buildings.next_action: Finish the held rendered stories, commission the missing launch set and build the complete Daily/newspaper surfaces.

buildings.name: Chick Flicks
buildings.opening_day_floor: Trailer and Episodes 01–04 are easy to discover, read, listen to and watch, with correct titles/covers, start-in-order/latest choices, portable listening and related learning.
buildings.acceptance_proof: Every format plays/opens, resumes where supported, uses exact released bytes and propagates corrections; Episode 03 is The Burn Book Problem.
buildings.next_action: Run the opening-day media gate: complete full-title audible watches for Episodes 01–03, rebuild the Trailer and Episode 04, and bind only exact all-gates-PASS masters and written pages into the opening-day catalogue.

buildings.name: Blend & Snap
buildings.opening_day_floor: The café is the Study Pack home and opens the complete Episode 01 Cheat Sheet, Try-On and Trading Card Pack with save/download/print and Closet handoffs.
buildings.acceptance_proof: All three items pass instructional, source, print/mobile, card-ownership, download and completion tests; no rejected placeholder art or duplicate Study Sheet appears.
buildings.next_action: Complete the admitted Episode 01 pack and integrate the authentic cards and Try-On into the café experience.

buildings.name: Mme CLAi-O's Shop
buildings.opening_day_floor: One complete playful card-reading experience with the correct character/art, clear entertainment boundaries, useful output and a distinct relationship to—but no false ownership of—the Daily Promptoscope.
buildings.acceptance_proof: Card selection, output variation, replay, mobile/accessibility, privacy and failure states pass; rejected/pixelated/incorrect art is absent.
buildings.next_action: Replace the rejected reading art and independently review the complete visitor journey.

buildings.name: MAiKEOVER on MAiN
buildings.opening_day_floor: Resident Card and My Closet visibly manage identity, saved progress, collections, rewards, charms/badges/cards and message entry with truthful signed-in/signed-out states.
buildings.acceptance_proof: Native add/remove, restore, account switch, cross-device, revocation, empty/error and accessibility journeys pass against authoritative stores.
buildings.next_action: Finish the Closet category/ownership contract, then close the staging account-entry and cross-context propagation matrix.

buildings.name: Bronze AiGE
buildings.opening_day_floor: Cocktail Fortune and the Businesswomen’s Special are both complete, legible, playful experiences with alcohol-safe language, real outcomes and appropriate KSVL/Closet/reward handoffs.
buildings.acceptance_proof: Both journeys pass content, rights/audio, alcohol-safety, mobile, accessibility, analytics, completion and failure/retry gates.
buildings.next_action: Close the current visual/native/audio/rights gates and bind each experience to a real completion event.

buildings.name: Dream Phone Booth
buildings.opening_day_floor: A coherent Dream Phone experience includes the funny caller/reflection game and the hallucination-detection challenge, with plain-language purpose and no misleading professional-advice promise.
buildings.acceptance_proof: Both modes pass comprehension, learning usefulness, replay, state, rewards, accessibility, mobile and failure tests with no bizarre internal labelling.
buildings.next_action: Lock the two-mode product model and build the hallucination challenge into the same visitor-facing experience.

buildings.name: The Mall
buildings.opening_day_floor: A coherent Mall hub shows only real open destinations and includes one functioning Scholastic-style Book Fair pilot with at least three useful digital/collectible items and truthful Butterfly Clip pricing/fulfilment.
buildings.acceptance_proof: Navigation, ownership, spend/refund, rights, fulfilment, stock/unavailable, accessibility and mobile journeys pass without fake commerce.
buildings.next_action: Define the three-item Book Fair launch catalogue and bind it to the shared economy/Closet before visual storefront completion.

buildings.name: KSVL Community RAiDIO
buildings.opening_day_floor: All 29 creator-confirmed songs are playable, discoverable and organized with correct artist/band, title, album art, playlist and portable-listening metadata.
buildings.acceptance_proof: Every track and playlist passes exact media, metadata, cover, background playback, accessibility, request-service and public-origin checks.
buildings.next_action: Close audio-quality/public-origin checks and generate the canonical platform-ready release manifests.

buildings.name: SUNNYVAiLE Post Office
buildings.opening_day_floor: Resident signup includes the Wednesday Postcard selected by default with a clear opt-out; a Postcard-only route supports confirmation, delivery, unsubscribe and retry without requiring a Resident Card.
buildings.acceptance_proof: Provider-backed subscribe/opt-out/confirm/deliver/unsubscribe/recover flows pass with consent receipts, duplicate handling and failure states.
buildings.next_action: Reconcile the correct consent copy and prove the real provider lifecycle.

buildings.name: Town Hall
buildings.opening_day_floor: Visitors can report a problem, offer feedback or submit an idea and receive a clear durable receipt, status and retry path.
buildings.acceptance_proof: Submit, validation, duplicate/idempotent retry, receipt, staff intake, privacy, accessibility and failure journeys pass end to end.
buildings.next_action: Connect the existing build packet to the authoritative submission service and staff queue.

buildings.name: SUNNYVAiLE LIBRAiRY
buildings.opening_day_floor: Miss Jeeves provides search/lookup across four admitted books—Vocab 101, Briefing 101, Setup 101 and Accounts 101—with exact-section links, related learning and saved continuation.
buildings.acceptance_proof: Books pass editorial/freshness/source review; search, exact-section reader, continuation, mobile, accessibility, empty/no-answer and related-content journeys pass with the approved modern Miss Jeeves image.
buildings.next_action: Reconcile the extracted Grimoire material into the four canonical books, then complete editorial admission and reader integration.

buildings.name: SUNNYVAiLE High
buildings.opening_day_floor: Three complete pathways serve different needs without permanent beginner/advanced labels: AI foundations; set up and use your AI well; and the intermediate What the Viral Reel Left Out lab.
buildings.acceptance_proof: Each path has a distinct observable skill, complete lesson, example, Try-On/practice, check, feedback, sources/freshness, related episode/book/tool and completion/Closet evidence.
buildings.next_action: Merge the current class inventory into these three paths and finish the missing production materials instead of publishing more previews.

buildings.name: FAiRY Godmother's House
buildings.opening_day_floor: The FAiRY Godmother helps improve a prompt or draft using user-provided context, keeps high-stakes/current-fact work outside the casual preview and clearly shows FAiRY Play balance/use.
buildings.acceptance_proof: Typed routing, useful output, uncertainty, privacy, provider failure, idempotent Play charge/refund, accessibility, mobile and reward-redemption tests pass.
buildings.next_action: Finish the answer-quality router and integrate it with the shared Plays/economy ledger.

buildings.name: Sorority House · Delta LAi Nu
buildings.opening_day_floor: Residents can find messages and participate in at least one general community room and one clearly scoped Girl Talk room, with mutual-advancement norms and real moderation.
buildings.acceptance_proof: Two-account post/reply/message/unread/report/block/moderation/account-isolation/mobile/accessibility/failure journeys pass and completion rewards real contribution rather than a page visit.
buildings.next_action: Reconcile the existing messaging service, define the two launch-room charters and implement the full moderated visitor journeys.

buildings.name: The LUMINAiRY
buildings.opening_day_floor: At least six fully sourced, rights-cleared profiles explain how women shaped computing's past and are shaping AI now, with distinct historical/current roles and related lessons, episodes and Library references.
buildings.acceptance_proof: Every claim, image/right, citation, link, related-content relationship, mobile/accessibility state and correction trigger passes independent review.
buildings.next_action: Select a balanced six-profile launch set from the held inventory and close evidence, writing, rights and visual admission one profile at a time.

execution_order.name: Shared truth and persistence
execution_order.work: Identity/continuation/Closet, rewards economy, content graph/search/freshness, media manifests, moderation/messaging, shared navigation and QA.

execution_order.name: Opening catalogue production
execution_order.work: Trailer/Episodes 01–04, three classes, four books, Episode 01 Study Pack, launch NewsStand/Daily set, six LUMINAiRY profiles, KSVL metadata and launch community rooms.

execution_order.name: Building verticals
execution_order.work: Complete every building against its floor, consuming the shared systems rather than inventing local substitutes. Multiple non-colliding buildings may move concurrently only when their shared dependencies are stable.

execution_order.name: Whole-town integration and release
execution_order.work: Homepage/Visitor's Centre/directories, cross-links, search, return states, full route/state QA, exact release artifact, deployed public verification and opening announcement.
